open-find.name: Open up find and search on selection
open-find.description: Hotkey to open up the custom find and search on selection.

create-permalink.name: Create permalink
create-permalink.description: Hotkey to expand the current url to a full permalink.

collapse-expand-comments.name: Collapse/Expand comments
collapse-expand-comments.description: swaps between having all comments collapsed or expanded

tab-forward.name: Track when a user tabs through the commit list
tab-forward.description: navigates through the tab-index items in the commit list

tab-backward.name: Track when a user tabs backwards through the commit list
tab-backward.description: navigates through the tab-index items in the commit list backwards
